components.name: Bet Button

components.css: .ds-btn-bet { background: #16a34a; color: #ffffff; width: 100%; padding: 18px 24px; font-family: 'Raleway', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.1s ease, background 0.1s ease, box-shadow 0.1s ease; box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.35); } .ds-btn-bet:hover { background: #15803d; } .ds-btn-bet:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Cashout Button
components.description: High-urgency action trigger to lock in multiplier and win coins before rocket crash.

narrative.overview: The visual world balances high-suspense arcade excitement with the sleekness of modern dark-mode mobile interfaces. Designed exclusively for the Telegram Mini App environment, the interface treats the screen as an illuminated cockpit window looking out into deep space: deep void blacks, velvety charcoal cards, and intense electric neon accents. Every visual cue delivers instant feedback.
keyCharacteristics: Pitch-black void foundations layered with warm charcoal card surfaces.
High-contrast semantic tri-state colors: Solar Gold (multiplier/cashout), Launch Green (active bet), and Nebula Crimson (crash event).
Tactile, chunky controls optimized for rapid single-thumb mobile interaction.
Space retro-arcade flair: parallax star fields, cosmic glow borders, and bold monospace telemetry numbers.

rules.name: The Tri-State Semantic Rule
rules.body: Buttons and status indicators must strictly reflect the current round phase: Launch Green while waiting/betting, Solar Gold while rocket is airborne and cashout is primed, and Nebula Crimson the instant the crash occurs. Never mix these state colors.

rules.name: The Voltage Rule
rules.body: High-saturation accents (Solar Gold, Launch Green, Nebula Crimson) may occupy at most 15% of the total surface area. The remaining 85% must remain dark neutrals so that state changes flash with maximum perceptual impact.

rules.name: The Telemetry Monospace Rule
rules.body: Any rapidly fluctuating numerical data (multiplier counter, live coin balances, round timer milliseconds) must use tabular monospace (`font-mono`) to prevent layout jitter as digits change.

rules.name: The Tonal Stratum Rule
rules.body: Elevate elements purely through background lightness: Void Black (#181a20) on floor -> Surface Charcoal (#1f2937) for cards -> Graphite (#374151) for inner controls. Never use light-colored drop shadows.

dos: Do anchor the primary action button to the bottom thumb zone for effortless one-handed play.
Do use tabular monospace (`font-mono`) for all live multiplier numbers and coin balances.
Do apply Solar Gold exclusively to currency, current multiplier, and cashout events.
Do support dark mode natively by anchoring the root surface to Void Black (#181a20).
Do provide visual pulse and state changes in under 100ms when bets are placed or cashed out.
donts: Don't introduce light or white backgrounds anywhere in the interface; the game world is strictly dark space.
Don't add complex multi-step betting sliders; stick to quick-tap preset chips (10, 50, 100) for fast round turnaround.
Don't use low-contrast gray text on dark cards; keep all labels at or above WCAG AA contrast (minimum `#9ca3af` for secondary text).
Don't allow desktop horizontal overflows or vertical layout jumps when the multiplier ascends.
